economic_hypothesis: Forced-supply reversal and quiet-inventory price discovery are different Alpha engines. Fast capitulation followed by active demand belongs in a causal broad BEAR state. Quiet-inventory breakout belongs only in a causal broad and meaningfully positive STRONG_BULL state; a merely positive but weak market does not provide enough continuation headroom.

routing.BEAR: exact frozen ASHARE-BEAR-FAST-CAPITULATION-ACTIVE-DEMAND-V10 accepted trade identity and T20/H60 execution

causal_market_state.bear: market median ret20 <= 0, median ret60 <= 0, positive-ret20 share <= 0.50, and positive-ret60 share <= 0.50 at the completed signal close
causal_market_state.strong_bull: base BULL plus market median ret60 >= 0.05 and positive-ret60 share >= 0.60 at the completed mother-signal close
causal_market_state.weak_bull: base BULL that does not meet STRONG_BULL
causal_market_state.economic_reason: five percent is a meaningful sixty-session median stock advance rather than a sign-only threshold; sixty percent breadth requires a clear majority of stocks to participate

bear_engine.stock_event: ret20 <= -10%, signal return >= +5%, close above prior-five high, turnover at least prior-20 mean, close location >=70%, non-limit close, and prior10 return <= -8%
bear_engine.market_event: causal BEAR and completed positive-ret20 breadth above its five-session lag
bear_engine.exit: +20% target or first legal open after H60 close decision

strong_bull_engine.stock_event: exact quiet-inventory information-gap mother event in base BULL
strong_bull_engine.acceptance: third subsequent completed tradable stock session closes at or above the pre-signal frozen prior-40 platform high
strong_bull_engine.entry: first legal open after the third-session acceptance decision
strong_bull_engine.exit: +20% target or first legal open after H60 close decision

development.post_hoc_status: Both engine directions and STRONG_BULL semantics are development hypotheses; no independent confirmation claim is allowed.
